## Problem

What external-client browser workflow is difficult or impossible today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest public contract that solves the problem.

## MCP/API sketch

Provide example schemas or calls when useful.

## Architecture considerations

Explain effects on session/page isolation, concurrency, lifecycle, persistence, security, and resource limits.

## Alternatives

What external-client or existing-tool approaches did you consider?

## Scope check

BrowserMesh is a browser runtime, not an internal LLM-agent orchestration framework. Features introducing internal agents, mailboxes, or agent-to-agent messaging are outside the v0.1 responsibility boundary.
